statement.text:
Let α be an automorphism of prime order q of an infinite free Burnside group
G = B(q, p) of prime exponent p such that α cyclically permutes the free generators
of G. Is it true that α fixes some non-trivial element of G?
   Editors’ comment: this is proved for q = 2 in (V. S. Atabekyan, H. T. Aslanyan,
Proc. Yerevan State Univ. Physic. Math. Sci., 53, no. 3 (2019), 147–149).
                                                                                V. D. Mazurov
